real.Milestone: M3.1, no symbols. With the oracle's own 18 symbols supplied it is 0.9970/0.8579; ./build.sh Fidelity reports both. The ratchet is the without-symbols number because that is what `skala format` does with no project.

constructs.Milestone: M10, formatter tags: constructs/arrangement/formatter-tags/ adds three files to the set, taking it from 324 to 327. All three are byte-identical to CSReformatCode's answer, so the number rises rather than falls — which is the point of committing them: the oracle honours the tags under the format-only profile and ignores them under the cleanup profile (SK-DIV-0016), and the .arranged.expected.cs beside each of these is where that is pinned. M9 was 324 files at 0.9745/0.9228.
